newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai to launch new property in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai to launch new property in 1997.

text.p: Property developer Wing Tai Holdings said on Saturday it would launch its new twin tower residential and commercial development around the first quarter of 1997.

The proposed mixed development, located in the southern area of Singapore has a floor area of 298,184 square feet and is made up of 60 percent apartments and 40 percent retail and office space, Wing Tai said in a statement.
Wing Tai said the project would have 179 apartment units ranging from 915 square feet to 1,292 square feet for two to three bedroom units over 16 floors.
It would also have 84 office units over eight floors and over 50 retail shops.
Kajima Overseas has been appointed the main contractor.
Wing Tai said its planned projects include high end residential developments in the northern Bukit Timah area.
